user.title: UCANESS portal login
user.description: UNOFFICIAL integration. Readings only by default; the inverter is controlled (work mode, charge windows) only if 'Write allowed' is enabled in the options. The EMS ID is shown in the portal 'Details' panel.

reauth_confirm.title: UCANESS re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The session was rejected. Enter your UCANESS password again.

error.device_not_found: No device found with this EMS ID.

init.title: UCANESS options
init.description: The application key is given by UCanpower (third-party API). Leave the secret empty to keep the one already saved. 'Write allowed' lets Home Assistant change the work mode (self-consumption or time-of-use) and the charge windows, nothing else.

data.write_enabled: Write allowed (work mode and charge windows only)

tester_api.name: Test the UCanpower API
tester_api.description: Read-only check of the signed third-party API: device identifier, inverter model, work mode and windows. Nothing is sent to the inverter.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: UCANESS entry to use (optional if only one device).

definir_plages_charge.name: Set charge windows
definir_plages_charge.description: Programs up to 3 charge windows of the time-of-use mode (HHMM). Other charge windows and all discharge windows are cleared. Requires 'Write allowed'.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: UCANESS entry to use (optional if only one device).

plages.name: Windows
plages.description: List of {debut, fin} in HHMM, for example 2300 to 2359 then 0000 to 0130.

definir_mode.name: Set work mode
definir_mode.description: Switches the inverter to self-consumption or time-of-use. Backup is not allowed. Requires 'Write allowed'.

config_entry_id.description: UCANESS entry to use (optional if only one device).
